processes.pipeline_imbalance_reconciliation: Staff investigate and reconcile pipeline imbalances and OA variances between pipeline statements, CPR/Unify bookings and payback scheduling.
processes.deal_price_invoice_discrepancy: Staff correct deal ticket rates or resolve counterparty disputes where invoiced deals or prices do not match.
processes.daily_actuals_volume_reporting: Counterparties and schedulers send estimated or scheduled daily volumes that the desk must receive and reconcile against its records.
